name: Manifold Markets
tagline: A platform for creating and trading prediction markets on political, cultural, and business outcomes
sdg_alignment: SDG 16 – Peace, Justice and Strong Institutions
dependency_risks: Regulatory uncertainty around prediction markets in various jurisdictions
Platform reliance on user participation and liquidity
news_articles: TechCrunch: Manifold Markets raises Series A to expand prediction market platform
The Guardian: How prediction markets are changing political forecasting
Wired: Inside the world of AI-powered prediction markets
academic_citations: Prediction Markets as Information Aggregation Mechanisms (various academic papers citing Manifold Markets)
Google Scholar entries for Manifold Markets forecasting accuracy studies
published_performance_metrics: Platform publishes market accuracy metrics and forecasting performance data
documented_limitations: Limited to users in jurisdictions where prediction markets are legally permitted
Market accuracy depends on participant knowledge and participation levels
jurisdictional_scope: Primarily United States with international access restrictions
failure_modes: Regulatory shutdown risk in certain jurisdictions
curation_criteria: Markets created by users; platform enforces resolution criteria and dispute resolution processes
contributor_governance: Community-driven market creation with platform moderation
controversies: Concerns about prediction markets enabling gambling-like behavior
Debates over market accuracy and potential for misinformation
legal_regulatory_issues: Prediction markets operate in legal gray area in many jurisdictions; platform restricts access based on location
elections_used_in: Various state and local election predictions

scraped.scraped_description: Manifold is a social prediction game. Bet on news, politics, tech, & AI with play money. Or create your own prediction market.

political_relevance_summary: Manifold Markets addresses enabling broader democratic participation and making civic data accessible and actionable.

movement_building_utility.notes: Serves as an information resource: A platform for creating and trading prediction markets on political, cultural, and business outcomes.

generalizability_notes: Open-source codebase enables replication. already deployed internationally across multiple jurisdictions.
